limitations: The requested local vault background file was unavailable; public papers and code were reviewed.
GAVD source groups are not verified independent patients; no external clinical validation was performed.
Five-class support is sparse and readout selection used binary validation; robust condition recognition is unestablished.
Bounded sequence prefixes, variable time horizons and incomplete person verification limit claims.
Primary JEPA versus RF and forecast versus persistence effects are inconclusive. Favorable secondary scores do not establish useful dynamics or calibrated clinical uncertainty.
The full positional/latent factorial experiment and full-sequence repeated-split training remain future work.
